description: MainActivity.kt is an Android activity written in Kotlin that manages the main user interface of a football live score and news platform. It handles navigation between different tabs (Home, Matches, News), manages user session, interacts with a backend API for data retrieval, and sets up real-time updates for live match information.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that provides the main user interface for the football live score and news platform, managing navigation, session, and data updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI elements, session check, navigation buttons, and performs initial health check.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Starts real-time updates for live match data when the activity becomes visible.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Stops real-time updates when the activity is no longer visible.

methods.name: switchTab
methods.description: Handles switching between tabs (Home, Matches, News), updating UI elements and fetching relevant data from the backend.

methods.name: setList
methods.description: Sets the ListView adapter with a list of string items to display.

methods.name: updateNavStyles
methods.description: Updates navigation button styles to reflect the currently active tab.
